alerts.analytics.comparison.title: Compared with the previous period
alerts.analytics.comparison.hint: Equal adjacent windows. Click a value to inspect its groups. Response times use completed samples within each window; open-now counters are not compared. Results use retained records and their saved lifecycle timestamps.
alerts.analytics.heatmap.title: When alert groups start
alerts.analytics.heatmap.hint: New groups by weekday and hour in the selected timezone. Click a non-empty cell to inspect its groups.
alerts.analytics.heatmap.legend: Darker cells mean more groups. Numbers are totals across the selected period, not daily averages.
alerts.analytics.growth.title: Largest increases in alert noise
alerts.analytics.growth.hint: Saved occurrences compared with the previous period, sorted by absolute increase. Names match exactly. A zero baseline means no occurrences in that previous period, not necessarily a new alert rule.
alerts.analytics.selection.title: Matching alert groups
alerts.analytics.selection.unlinked: {count} occurrences have no accessible parent group. Counts in this list include only occurrences matching the selected name and period.
alerts.analytics.title: Alert analytics
alerts.analytics.subtitle: Noise, acknowledgement quality and unresolved alert groups for the selected period.
alerts.analytics.lifecycle.title: Alert lifecycle trend
alerts.analytics.lifecycle.subtitle: Groups created, acknowledged and resolved by day.
alerts.analytics.noisy.title: Noisiest alerts
alerts.analytics.noisy.subtitle: Highest persisted alert occurrences in the selected period.
alerts.analytics.oldest.title: Oldest unresolved
alerts.analytics.oldest.subtitle: Current actionable open groups, including groups older than the selected period.
alerts.analytics.attention.title: Acknowledgement health
alerts.analytics.attention.subtitle: Current response gaps and alert rules that frequently resolve without acknowledgement.
alerts.analytics.attention.needs_ack.sub: Open firing groups that still need an acknowledgement, sorted by priority and age.
alerts.analytics.attention.resolved_with: Aggregated by alert name across groups resolved in the selected period.
